argument: After minimal mailbox quoting produces identical address bytes, concatenation without repetition, alternatives, captures or locale classes accepts the same fixed-length byte sequences at the same start offsets. Outer anchors restrict offsets identically. Patterns remain unchanged. This is not general ERE equivalence.
grammar: ascii-concatenation-v1: nonempty printable ASCII concatenation; optional leading ^ and trailing $; dot matches one byte; [.] and escaped . \ + ? * ( ) { } | ^ $ [ are literal; all other metacharacters, classes, groups, repetitions, backreferences and escapes rejected
oracle_required: Actual generated output sievec compilation and sieve-test simulation plus shared native classifier against every authored winner; unsupported grammar fails publication.
sieve: Pigeonhole 2.4.5 address :all :regex comparator i;ascii-casemap; DREGEX_ICASE|DREGEX_ASCII_ONLY; PCRE2_NEVER_UTF; unsigned byte conversion
upstream: Signed Dovecot/Pigeonhole 2.4.5 releases pinned by vendor/sources.json; optional PCRE2-32 development dependency, never application runtime
